spec.description: Who is connected to TimescaleDB, how close is it to the limit, and is anyone failing to log in?
Backends connected to timescale_home, including background workers.
spec.title: Connections

spec.description: Every group of connections right now.
spec.title: Connections now

spec.description: Commits and rollbacks. Rollbacks above zero for long means failing statements.
spec.title: Transactions per second

spec.description: Per hour. Deadlocks and conflicts should stay at zero; temp files mean queries spilled to disk.
spec.title: Deadlocks, conflicts and temp files

spec.description: Wrong passwords and unknown users in the selected range.
spec.title: Failed logins

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="web_timescaledb"} |~ "no pg_hba.conf entry|unsupported frontend protocol|invalid length of startup packet|no PostgreSQL user name" [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.description: Connections refused before login: no matching pg_hba rule, bad protocol or no user name.
spec.title: Rejected connections

spec.expr: count(sum by (user) (count_over_time({container="web_timescaledb"} |~ "authentication failed" | regexp `user "(?P<user>[^"]+)"` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.description: Different user names that failed to log in.
spec.title: Users tried

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="web_timescaledb"} |~ "no pg_hba.conf entry|unsupported frontend protocol|invalid length of startup packet|no PostgreSQL user name" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

spec.description: Per interval. Scanners hammered the database before it stopped listening on the public address; anything now is worth a look.
spec.title: Failed logins and rejected connections

spec.expr: {container="web_timescaledb"} |~ "authentication failed|no pg_hba.conf entry|unsupported frontend protocol|invalid length of startup packet|no PostgreSQL user name"

spec.description: Failed logins and refused connections, newest first. Connection logging is off, so successful logins are not listed.
